armyRules.name: Curse of the Wulfen
armyRules.description: While this unit is within 6" of one or more friendly Space Wolves Character models (excluding Wulfen models) or within 12" of one or more friendly Wolf Priest models, if it is not Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of Infantry models in it and add 3 to the Objective Control characteristic of Vehicle models in it.

armyRules.name: Mission Tactics
armyRules.description:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Mission Tactics listed below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Mission Tactic is active and its effects apply to all units from your army with this ability. Each Mission Tactic can only be selected once per battle.

FUROR TACTICS

While this Mission Tactic is active, weapons equipped by ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

MALLEUS TACTICS

While this Mission Tactic is active, weapons equipped by ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

PURGATUS TACTICS

While this Mission Tactic is active, each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army makes an attack, if a Critical Hit is scored, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.

armyRules.name: Templar Vows
armyRules.description:
If your Army Faction is ADEPTUS ASTARTES, at the start of the first battle round, select one of the following Vows to be active for ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army. While a Vow is active for a unit from your army, that unit has the associated ability shown below.

Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch

This unit's melee attacks that target a PSYKER unit have the [PRECISION] ability. When this unit declares a charge, if an enemy PSYKER unit is within 12″ of this unit, you can use this part of this ability. If you do: this unit can re-roll that Charge roll, but this unit must end that charge move engaged with one or more of those enemy PSYKER units.

Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds

Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than or equal to the Toughness characteristic of the target, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Suffer Not the Unclean to Live

This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back, and each time a model in this unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

Uphold the Honour of the Emperor

If this unit has the INFANTRY keyword:

  • At the end of your Command phase, if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
  • If the mission you are playing features Actions, this unit is eligible to start to perform an Action in a turn in which it Advanced.

options.name: Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch
Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds
Suffer Not the Unclean to Live
Uphold the Honour of the Emperor

armyRules.name: Assigned Agents
armyRules.description:
If your Army Faction is AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, then in the Select Detachment Rules step, you can select one of the available Detachments from this book as normal.

If your Army Faction is not AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, but every model in your army has the IMPERIUM keyword, you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units in your army even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected in the Select Army Faction step. In this case, the maximum number of AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units you can include in your army depends on the battle size, as shown below.

BATTLE SIZERETINUE UNITSCHARACTER UNITSREQUISITIONED UNITS
Incursion111
Strike Force221
Onslaught332

Note that you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEDICATED TRANSPORT units in such an army as normal, but each unit must start the battle with one or more units embarked within it, or it cannot be deployed for that battle and will count as having been destroyed during the first battle round.

armyRules.name: Kill Team
armyRules.description:
Each time an attack targets this unit, if it contains models with different Toughness characteristics, until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, use the Toughness characteristic of the majority of the models in that unit when determining what roll is required for that attack to successfully wound. If two or more Toughness characteristics are tied for majority, use the highest value.

For the purposes of determining which models in this unit can embark within a Transport, Kill Team Terminator models, Kill Team Outrider models, Kill Team Biker models and models equipped with a jump pack each take up the space of 2 models, but can otherwise embark within any TRANSPORT their unit can embark within, even though similar models in other units have the Terminator, Mounted or Jump Pack keywords.

For the purposes of interacting with terrain features, all models in units with this ability are considered INFANTRY models, even though similar models in other units may have the MOUNTED or JUMP PACK keywords.

Designer’s Note: While the abstractions in the above rule cause some models to behave differently to similar models in other units, they are designed to minimise complicated movement, TRANSPORT and Benefit of Cover rules.

armyRules.name: Combat Doctrines
armyRules.description:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

ASSAULT DOCTRINE
When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

DEVASTATOR DOCTRINE
This unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

TACTICAL DOCTRINE
When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.

Unless otherwise stated:
  • You can only select each combat doctrine once per battle.
  • Only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

armyRules.name: Transhuman Strategist
armyRules.description: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

armyRules.name: Librarius
armyRules.description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name.

In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit's psyker level.

Example: In a battle round, a psyker level 3 PSYKER unit could use three psychic level 1 abilities, or one psychic level 1 ability and one psychic level 2 ability, or one psychic level 3 ability.

abilities.name: Mission Tactics
abilities.description: Friendly KILL TEAM units gain a bonus based on the active Combat Doctrine: Devastator Doctrine grants the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability (Furor Tactics); Tactical Doctrine grants the [LETHAL HITS] ability (Malleus Tactics); Assault Doctrine grants the [PRECISION] ability against units within 9" (Purgatus Tactics).

abilities.name: Vowed Target
abilities.description: In your Command phase, select one objective marker to be your Vowed Objective Marker. Each time a friendly DEATHWING INFANTRY unit's attacks target an enemy unit within range of your Vowed Objective Marker, add 1 to the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Legacy of the Angel
abilities.description: Friendly CHARACTER units from your army can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

abilities.name: The Great Wolf Watches
abilities.description: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER units have the following ability — Countercharge (Once per battle round, per unit): You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem regardless of any other use of that Stratagem this phase; if you do, that use costs 1CP less (to a minimum of 0CP).

abilities.name: Dutiful Tenacity
abilities.description: Each time an attack targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit, if that attack's Strength characteristic is greater than that unit's Toughness characteristic, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Legendary Slayers
abilities.description: Melee attacks made by friendly BLOOD CLAWS, THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY and WULFEN units have the [LETHAL HITS] ability against CHARACTER, MONSTER and VEHICLE units.

abilities.name: Faith-Fuelled Resolve
abilities.description:
Friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD units have +1 OC.

RESTRICTIONS
Your army can include BLACK TEMPLARS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

abilities.name: Wrath of Angels
abilities.description:
When a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit is selected to make a Fall Back move, that move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to shoot or eligible to declare a charge.

RESTRICTIONS
Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

abilities.name: Fanatical Celerity
abilities.description:
When a friendly DEATH COMPANY unit is selected to make an advance move, you can use this ability. If you do: that unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds; and that move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

This detachment has the DOOMED tag and cannot be taken with another DOOMED detachment.

RESTRICTIONS
Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

abilities.name: Black-winged Vengeance
abilities.description: Friendly RAVENWING FLY units' ranged attacks have the [IGNORES COVER] ability. Friendly OUTRIDER SQUAD units have the BATTLELINE keyword.

abilities.name: Codex Discipline
abilities.description: You can select one combat doctrine one additional time per battle.

abilities.name: Assault Mastery
abilities.description: You can select the assault doctrine one additional time per battle.

abilities.name: Tactical Mastery
abilities.description: You can select the tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.

abilities.name: Devastator Mastery
abilities.description: You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.

abilities.name: Death Blow
abilities.description: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR units have +1 to charge rolls.

abilities.name: Wrath of the Chapter
abilities.description: Friendly TACTICUS units can re-roll advance rolls.

abilities.name: Codex Fire-Patterns
abilities.description: Friendly TACTICUS units' [RAPID FIRE] attacks benefit from [RAPID FIRE] when targeting units up to that attack's maximum range.

abilities.name: Shadow Masters
abilities.description:
When a friendly PHOBOS or SCOUT SQUAD unit has shot:
  • Those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden.
  • Or: That unit can make a normal move of up to D6". That unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

abilities.name: Vanguard Ambushers
abilities.description: At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly PHOBOS unit is hidden, that unit's attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

abilities.name: Walking Fortress
abilities.description:
In a turn a friendly GRAVIS unit made a normal move, that unit's ranged attacks:
  • Do not have [HEAVY].
  • Have +1 to hit rolls.

abilities.name: Indomitable Defence
abilities.description: While a friendly GRAVIS unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit's T have -1 to wound rolls.

abilities.name: Lightning-fast Strike
abilities.description: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER units have +2" M.

abilities.name: Enduring Vengeance
abilities.description: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT units can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

abilities.name: Combined Deployment
abilities.description:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is assailed until the end of the turn:
  • While a unit is assailed, when an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

abilities.name: Ironstorm Auto-Targeters
abilities.description:
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE units' (excluding WALKER units) ranged attacks can:
  • Re-roll one hit roll.
  • Re-roll one wound roll.

abilities.name: Armoured Wrath
abilities.description: Each time a friendly unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for that unit. If your army includes CAANOK VAR or IRON FATHER FEIRROS, each of those models has a 6" aura: while a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within range of one or more of those models, each time that unit is selected to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll AND one Damage roll made for that unit (instead of just one of the three).

abilities.name: Templar Vows
abilities.description:
At the start of the first Battle Round, select one of the following Vows; it applies to your Adeptus Astartes units for the rest of the battle:
  • Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch: Melee attacks made by your units against PSYKER units have the [PRECISION] and [LANCE] abilities.
  • Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds: Add 1 to the Wound roll for melee attacks made by your units that target a unit with a Toughness characteristic greater than that attack's Strength characteristic.
  • Uphold the Honour of the Emperor: Your INFANTRY units that are controlling an objective marker at the end of your Movement phase Secure that objective marker, and can still be given an Advance order or perform an Action that phase.

abilities.name: Mastered Doctrines
abilities.description: If your army includes a MARNEUS CALGAR model, each time you would select a Combat Doctrine, you can select it twice instead of once (subject to the normal once-per-doctrine-per-battle-round restrictions). Requires MARNEUS CALGAR.

abilities.name: Masters of Shadow
abilities.description: All friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units have the Stealth ability. All friendly PHOBOS and SCOUT SQUAD units have -3" Detection Range. If your army includes AETHON SHAAN, friendly AETHON SHAAN units have the following ability — Unparalleled Tactician (Once per battle round, once per army): When you use the Into Darkness stratagem, that use costs 1CP less (to a minimum of 0CP).

abilities.name: Vulkan's Quest
abilities.description: You can select the Devastator Doctrine an additional time per battle (subject to the normal once-per-battle-round restriction). Each time a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within 12", add 1 to that attack's Strength characteristic. If your army includes VULKAN HE'STAN, friendly INFERNUS SQUAD units can Advance or Fall Back and still perform an Action that phase, and if an INFERNUS SQUAD unit performs an Action, it can still be selected to shoot in that phase.

abilities.name: Adaptive Defence
abilities.description: While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within a terrain feature, re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for that unit's attacks. A friendly unit is Entrenched while it is within a terrain feature and it was not set up on the battlefield this phase and has not moved more than 3" this phase. If your army includes DARNATH LYSANDER or TOR GARADON, that model's unit is treated as being Entrenched at all times, regardless of the above conditions.

abilities.name: Purge and Sanctify
abilities.description: Each time a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit makes a Surge move, you can choose for that unit to move towards the closest objective marker instead of towards a Surge target; each model in that unit must end that move as close as possible to that objective marker (and, having no Surge target, cannot end that move within Engagement Range of any enemy units).

abilities.name: Mission Tactics and Deathwatch Allies
abilities.description: Friendly KILL TEAM units gain a bonus based on the active Combat Doctrine: Devastator Doctrine grants [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (Furor Tactics); Tactical Doctrine grants [LETHAL HITS] (Malleus Tactics); Assault Doctrine grants [PRECISION] against units within 9" (Purgatus Tactics). Deathwatch Allies: your army can include up to 500 points of DEATHWATCH units in addition to your other Chapter's units (normally armies cannot mix units from different Chapters); a DEATHWATCH unit cannot be your Warlord, and KILL TEAM units can only be given Enhancements from this Detachment. Characters attached to a Kill Team count towards that 500-point limit; transports (other than the Corvus Blackstar) do not.

abilities.name: Storm-Swift Onslaught
abilities.description: You can select the Assault Doctrine or the Tactical Doctrine an additional time per battle (subject to the normal once-per-battle-round restriction). Add 1 to Advance rolls for friendly MOUNTED and SPEEDER units. If your army includes a SUBODEN KHAN unit, that unit gains the following ability — Wrath of the First Khan: If this unit is Engaged at the end of the Fight phase, it can make a Fall Back move; otherwise, it can make a Normal move.

stratagems.name: SLAYERS OF ABOMINATIONS
stratagems.description:
WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +2 S.

stratagems.name: BLADE OF DETESTATION
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit ends a Charge move.

TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

stratagems.name: UNSPARING EXECUTION
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a Fall Back move, if that unit is engaged with a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.

TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a Fall Back move, that enemy unit must use the Desperate Escape mode, with -1 to those Hazardous tests if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: JUDGEMENT OF THE GOLDEN HOST
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit ends a Charge move.

TARGET: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: INEXORABLE VALOUR
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit ends a Fall Back move, if that SANGUINARY GUARD unit is unengaged.

TARGET: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: BLINDING BLURS OF VENGEANCE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit.

TARGET: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has the Stealth ability.

stratagems.name: DEATH BEGETS VENGEANCE
stratagems.type: Wrath of the Doomed – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.

TARGET: That enemy unit.

EFFECT: That enemy unit is hated until the end of the battle. While a unit is hated, friendly DEATH COMPANY units' attacks that target that unit have +1 to Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: NO BARRIER TO RETRIBUTION
stratagems.type: Wrath of the Doomed – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement or your Charge phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Charge move.

TARGET: That DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has the MOBILE keyword.

stratagems.name: RAGEFUELLED RESPONSE
stratagems.type: Wrath of the Doomed – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DEATH COMPANY unit has shot.

TARGET: That DEATH COMPANY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.type: Gladius Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: A WORTHY DEATH
stratagems.type: Gladius Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:
  • On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: MIGHT OF ANGELS
stratagems.type: Gladius Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks have [LANCE].

stratagems.name: ADAPTIVE STRATEGY
stratagems.type: Gladius Task Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: STORM OF DEVASTATION
stratagems.type: Gladius Task Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: RESPONSIVE TACTICS
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.phase: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: GENE-WROUGHT MIGHT
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks have:
  • [LANCE].
  • Or: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, [LANCE] and +1 AP.

stratagems.name: DUTY IN DEATH
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if the assault doctrine is active for your unit:
  • On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.phase: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: DOMINATION FIRE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has shot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn:
  • While a unit is suppressed, that unit's attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: MASTERFUL TACTICS
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
  • Up to D6".
  • Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.phase: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: STORM OF FIRE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks have:
  • [IGNORES COVER].
  • Or: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, [IGNORES COVER] and +1 AP.

stratagems.name: HAIL OF VENGEANCE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if those attacks destroyed a model in a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL DREADNOUGHT FORTITUDE
stratagems.type: Terminator Storm Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: MERCILESS VETERANS
stratagems.type: Terminator Storm Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks have:
  • [LETHAL HITS].
  • [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: GUNSHIP EXTRACTION
stratagems.type: Terminator Storm Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.phase: End of your opponent’s Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagems.type: Tacticus Attack Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's attacks have:
  • [SUSTAINED HITS 1: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].
  • Or: [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

stratagems.name: TRANSHUMAN SWIFTNESS
stratagems.type: Tacticus Attack Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.

TARGET: One friendly TACTICUS unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.

EFFECT: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL FOCUS
stratagems.type: Tacticus Attack Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to make a consolidation move.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: When making that consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: FOR THE EMPEROR!
stratagems.type: Tacticus Firestorm Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly TACTICUS unit that is within range of an objective.

EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagems.type: Tacticus Firestorm Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's attacks have:
  • [SUSTAINED HITS 1: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].
  • Or: [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

stratagems.name: POINT-BLANK BRUTALITY
stratagems.type: Tacticus Firestorm Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged TACTICUS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks (excluding [BLAST] attacks) have:
  • [CLOSE-QUARTERS].
  • [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
stratagems.type: Phobos Shadow Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's attacks have:
  • +1 S.
  • [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: MORTIS SNARES
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: If your unit is controlling an objective, that objective is snared. While an objective is snared, when an enemy unit ends a move within range of that objective, roll one D6:
  • On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.
  • That objective is no longer snared.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
stratagems.type: Phobos Shadow Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.phase: End of your opponent’s Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
stratagems.type: Phobos Shock Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's attacks have:
  • +1 S.
  • [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: TRANSHUMAN REACTIONS
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged PHOBOS unit.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
  • Up to D6".
  • Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

stratagems.name: UMBRAL EVASION
stratagems.type: Phobos Shock Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PHOBOS unit.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
stratagems.type: Gravis Linebreaker Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: PURGATION PUSH
stratagems.type: Gravis Linebreaker Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT:
  • If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move of up to 5", and must end that move within range of an objective.
  • Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: ARMOURED IMPACT
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: When your unit ends a charge move, you can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
  • For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
stratagems.type: Gravis Siege Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: STAND UNYIELDING
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: SUPPRESSION VOLLEYS
stratagems.type: Gravis Siege Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: WIND-SWIFT EVASION
stratagems.type: Stormlance Task Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit that was eligible to fight this phase.

EFFECT:
  • If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move.
  • Or: If your unit is engaged, your unit can make a fall-back move.

stratagems.name: SUDDEN ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit is selected to make an advance move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can change its advance rolls to a 6.

stratagems.name: HURTLING TARGETS
stratagems.type: Stormlance Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: ADAMANTINE TERROR
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: MERCY IS WEAKNESS
stratagems.phase: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's attacks have:
  • [LETHAL HITS].
  • Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: UNSTOPPABLE ADVANCE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: AGGRESSIVE DISEMBARKATION
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within a TRANSPORT is selected to move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: While making that move, each model in your unit can be set up within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

This allows you to set up your unit within the set-up distance of your TRANSPORT, instead of wholly within that distance.

stratagems.name: DUTY IS NEVER DONE
stratagems.type: Gauntlet Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase, is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit, and is eligible to embark within that TRANSPORT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

stratagems.name: STORM AND SECURE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit that has an ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit embarked within it.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: LAYERED CERAMITE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: MIGHT OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER units).

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit's:
  • M.
  • BS.
  • Hit rolls and wound rolls.

stratagems.name: HEADHUNTER DOCTRINE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER units) is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

stratagems.name: ANCIENT FURY
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly DREADNOUGHT unit. EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to that unit's Move, Toughness, Leadership and Objective Control characteristics, and add 1 to Hit rolls for attacks made by that unit.

stratagems.name: SPIRITS OF IRON
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, that unit has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: MERCY IS WEAKNESS
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly unit that has been selected to shoot or fight. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, that unit's attacks have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability; if that unit is a VEHICLE, also add 1 to Wound rolls for its attacks.

stratagems.name: UNBOWED CONVICTION
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly unit that is below its Starting Strength. EFFECT: Until the end of the round, that unit's models can ignore any or all modifiers to their Ballistic Skill and Weapon Skill characteristics, and to Hit rolls and Wound rolls made for them.

stratagems.name: POWER OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after a VEHICLE unit from your army has been targeted by one or more enemy attacks. TARGET: That VEHICLE unit, if it was not destroyed. EFFECT: That unit can be selected to shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, firing as if making an Overwatch attack; if it is at or below Half-strength, it fires normally instead.

stratagems.name: VENGEFUL ANIMUS
stratagems.description: WHEN: A friendly VEHICLE unit is destroyed. EFFECT: That unit's Deadly Demise ability is automatically triggered (treat the test as passed, at maximum effect where applicable).

stratagems.name: DEVOUT PUSH
stratagems.description: WHEN: An INFANTRY unit from your army piles in or consolidates. EFFECT: That unit can move D3+3" instead of up to 3".

stratagems.name: DREAD CRUSADERS
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Charge phase, when an enemy unit selects its charge targets and one of them is a friendly INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test with -1 to the result.

stratagems.name: FOR THE EMPEROR'S HONOUR
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, that unit's attacks have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: HERESY BEGETS RETRIBUTION
stratagems.description: WHEN: An enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: That friendly unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: PIOUS ENMITY
stratagems.description: WHEN: A friendly CHAPLAIN or JUDICIAR unit is selected to fight. EFFECT: That unit can re-roll Hit rolls of 1; if the target is a MONSTER or VEHICLE, that unit can also re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: SPOOR OF THE UNHOLY
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly unit. EFFECT: That unit's attacks can ignore any or all modifiers to Ballistic Skill, Weapon Skill and Hit rolls this phase.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.type: Blade of Ultramar – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly unit. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: PRACTICAL TACTICS
stratagems.type: Blade of Ultramar – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: WHEN: An enemy unit ends a move within 8" of an unengaged friendly INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit. EFFECT: That friendly unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: COURAGE AND HONOUR!
stratagems.type: Blade of Ultramar – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly unit. EFFECT: That unit's melee attacks have the [LANCE] ability until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL FORESIGHT
stratagems.type: Blade of Ultramar – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly unit under attack. EFFECT: Subtract 1 from Wound rolls for attacks that target that unit this phase, if the attack's Strength is greater than that unit's Toughness.

stratagems.name: EXEMPLARY VIGILANCE
stratagems.type: Blade of Ultramar – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly unit selected to shoot. EFFECT: That unit's ranged attacks ignore the Benefit of Cover this phase.

stratagems.name: ULTRAMARIAN ADAPTIVITY
stratagems.type: Blade of Ultramar – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly unit. EFFECT: That unit gains the benefit of the Combat Doctrine of your choice until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: FEINT AND THRUST
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly unit. EFFECT: That unit is treated as being in the Tactical Doctrine, in addition to any other active Combat Doctrine, until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: MURDEROUS FUSILADE
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly unit that made an Ingress move this turn. EFFECT: Add 1 to that unit's Ballistic Skill characteristic and 1 to the AP characteristic of its ranged weapons' attacks until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: INTO DARKNESS
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase. TARGET: One unengaged friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: LAY LOW THE TYRANTS
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: That unit's melee attacks have the [PRECISION] ability until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: SUPPRESSED WEAPONS
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that has shot this phase. EFFECT: That unit's attack does not prevent it from being eligible to remain Hidden (per this Detachment's Masters of Shadow Stealth benefit) this turn.

stratagems.name: BLAZING EARTH
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of your opponent's Charge phase. TARGET: One enemy unit within 12" of a friendly [TORRENT] or [MELTA]-equipped ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. EFFECT: Subtract 1 from Charge rolls for that enemy unit this phase.

stratagems.name: FORGED IN FIRE
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when an engaged friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, remove the [BLAST] ability from that unit's ranged attacks, and give them the [CLOSE-QUARTERS] ability and +1 Attacks.

stratagems.name: BURNING VENGEANCE
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit is targeted by an attack. TARGET: One friendly unit embarked within that TRANSPORT. EFFECT: That unit can disembark and shoot at the enemy unit that targeted the transport, using normal Shooting-phase rules.

stratagems.name: IMMOLATION PROTOCOLS
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack. EFFECT: That unit's [TORRENT] weapons have +1 to their AP characteristic until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: CRUCIBLE OF BATTLE
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack an enemy unit within 6". TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: That unit can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1 this phase.

stratagems.name: WRATH AND RUIN
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: That unit gains the benefit of the Assault Doctrine or the Tactical Doctrine (your choice) that turn.

stratagems.name: AUGMENTED TARGETING
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly unit selected to shoot or fight. EFFECT: That unit's attacks gain the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability (your choice) until the end of the phase; if that unit is Entrenched, it gains both.

stratagems.name: PRIORITY STRIKE
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit selected to shoot or fight, targeting a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Add 1 to Wound rolls for that unit's attacks against that target this phase.

stratagems.name: ESTABLISH SUPREMACY
stratagems.description: WHEN: An Entrenched friendly unit consolidates in the Fight phase. EFFECT: That unit can make an Objective Control-consolidation move even if it is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: STAND TO THE END
stratagems.phase: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly non-MONSTER, non-VEHICLE unit under attack. EFFECT: Subtract 1 from Wound rolls for attacks with a Strength characteristic greater than that unit's Toughness this phase; if that unit is Entrenched, subtract 1 from all Wound rolls that target it this phase instead.

stratagems.name: EVASIVE REPOSITIONING
stratagems.description: WHEN: An unengaged friendly INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit loses a wound as a result of an enemy ranged attack. EFFECT: That unit can make a Normal move of up to D6" (or D3+3" if it is Entrenched).

stratagems.name: UNYIELDING MIGHT
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly unit on an objective marker. EFFECT: Add 1 to that unit's Objective Control characteristic until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: ANGELS DEFIANT
stratagems.type: Fist of the God-Emperor – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: WHEN: An enemy unit targets a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit with an attack whose Strength characteristic is greater than that unit's Toughness. EFFECT: Subtract 1 from the Wound roll for that attack until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: AVOWED DESTRUCTION
stratagems.type: Fist of the God-Emperor – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit. EFFECT: That unit's melee attacks gain the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability (your choice) until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: DOCTRINAL FLEXIBILITY
stratagems.type: Fist of the God-Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit. EFFECT: That unit gains the benefit of the Combat Doctrine of your choice until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: BLACKSTAR EXTRACTION
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase. TARGET: One unengaged friendly KILL TEAM unit. EFFECT: Remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: DRAGONFIRE ROUNDS
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly KILL TEAM unit. EFFECT: That unit's ranged attacks can re-roll Wound rolls of 1 and have the [IGNORES COVER] ability until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: HELLFIRE ROUNDS
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly KILL TEAM unit. EFFECT: That unit's ranged attacks (other than attacks made with weapons that have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability) have the [ANTI-NON-VEHICLE 4+] ability until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: EVASIVE MANOEUVRES
stratagems.type: Spearpoint Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when a friendly MOUNTED or SPEEDER unit is targeted by a ranged attack. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Subtract 1 from Wound rolls for ranged attacks that target that unit for the rest of the phase.

stratagems.name: FLAWLESS RIDERS
stratagems.type: Spearpoint Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly MOUNTED unit. EFFECT: That unit has the MOBILE ability until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: HUNTER'S INSTINCTS
stratagems.type: Spearpoint Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: WHEN: An enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly INFANTRY, MOUNTED or SPEEDER unit. EFFECT: That friendly unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: MOBILE LETHALITY
stratagems.type: Spearpoint Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: WHEN: A friendly unit makes an Advance or Fall Back move. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: That unit's ranged weapons have the [ASSAULT] ability, and that unit remains eligible to shoot this phase even though it Fell Back, until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: SPEAR THRUST AND SABRE SWING
stratagems.type: Spearpoint Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: WHEN: A friendly unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: That unit gains the [LETHAL HITS] or [LANCE] ability (your choice) until the end of the phase; if that unit is MOUNTED, it gains both instead.

stratagems.name: WITHDRAW AND REGROUP
stratagems.type: Spearpoint Task Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase. TARGET: One unengaged friendly MOUNTED or SPEEDER unit. EFFECT: Remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: IN SACRIFICE, VICTORY
stratagems.type: Wrath of the Rock – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly DEATHWING or RAVENWING unit within range of an objective marker you control is destroyed. EFFECT: That objective marker is Secured.

stratagems.name: INESCAPABLE JUSTICE
stratagems.type: Wrath of the Rock – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight. EFFECT: That unit's melee attacks have the [PRECISION] ability until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: KNIGHTS OF IRON
stratagems.type: Wrath of the Rock – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement or Charge phase, when a friendly RAVENWING unit makes a move or declares a charge. EFFECT: That unit has the MOBILE ability until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: LION'S WILL
stratagems.type: Wrath of the Rock – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: WHEN: Command phase. TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within range of an objective marker. EFFECT: Add 1 to that unit's Objective Control characteristic until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: RELICS OF THE DARK AGE
stratagems.type: Wrath of the Rock – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit is selected to shoot. EFFECT: Add 2 to the Strength characteristic of that unit's ranged attacks until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL MASTERY
stratagems.type: Wrath of the Rock – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly DEATHWING or RAVENWING unit. EFFECT: That unit gains the benefit of the Combat Doctrine of your choice until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: DUTY UNTO DEATH
stratagems.type: Inner Circle Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly DEATHWING unit. EFFECT: That unit's Fights on Death ability triggers on a 4+ (instead of the normal threshold); if that unit is engaged with an enemy unit within range of your Vowed Objective Marker, on a 3+ instead.

stratagems.name: RELIC TELEPORTARIUM
stratagems.type: Inner Circle Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly DEATHWING unit with the Deep Strike ability makes an Ingress move. EFFECT: That unit can be set up more than 6" (instead of more than 8") from all enemy models; that unit cannot declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: WRATH OF THE LION
stratagems.type: Inner Circle Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly DEATHWING unit ends a Charge move. TARGET: One enemy unit engaged with that unit. EFFECT: Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit; for each result of 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

stratagems.name: FOCUSED FURY
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Fight phase, when a unit is selected to fight. EFFECT: That unit's melee attacks have the [LETHAL HITS] ability; if that unit is a CHARACTER unit, it also has the [LANCE] ability.

stratagems.name: IN THE SHADOW OF GREAT WINGS
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly CHARACTER unit. EFFECT: That unit has the Stealth ability and -3" Detection Range until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: INSTANT OF GRACE
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: That unit has the CHARACTER keyword until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: MEASURED STRATEGIST
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly CHARACTER unit. EFFECT: That unit gains the benefit of the Combat Doctrine of your choice until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: STRIKE NOW FOR GLORY
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a unit is selected to shoot. EFFECT: That unit's ranged attacks have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.name: UNTO THE BURNING SKIES

abilities.name: Deep Strike
abilities.description:
DEEP STRIKE
During the Declare Battle Formations step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can set it up in Reserves instead of setting it up on the battlefield. If you do, in the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases you can set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy models. If a unit with the Deep Strike ability arrives from Strategic Reserves, the controlling player can choose for that unit to be set up either using the rules for Strategic Reserves or using the Deep Strike ability.
  • Unit can be set up in Reserves instead of on the battlefield.
  • Unit can be set up in your Reinforcements step, more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy models.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
LEADER
Some CHARACTER units have ‘Leader’ listed on their datasheets. Such CHARACTER units are known as Leaders, and the units they can lead – known as their Bodyguard units – are listed on their datasheet.

During the Declare Battle Formations step, for each Leader in your army, if your army also includes one or more of that Leader’s Bodyguard units, you can select one of those Bodyguard units. That Leader will then attach to that Bodyguard unit for the duration of the battle and is said to be leading that unit. Each Bodyguard unit can only have one Leader attached to it.

While a Bodyguard unit contains a Leader, it is known as an Attached unit and, with the exception of rules that are triggered when units are destroyed, it is treated as a single unit for all rules purposes. Each time an attack targets an Attached unit, until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, you must use the Toughness characteristic of the Bodyguard models in that unit, even if a Leader in that unit has a different Toughness characteristic. Each time an attack sucessfully wounds an Attached unit, that attack cannot be allocated to a CHARACTER model in that unit, even if that CHARACTER model has lost one or more wounds or has already had attacks allocated to it this phase. As soon as the last Bodyguard model in an Attached unit has been destroyed, any attacks made against that unit that have yet to be allocated can then be allocated to CHARACTER models in that unit.

Each time the last model in a Bodyguard unit is destroyed, each CHARACTER unit that is part of that Attached unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time the last model in a CHARACTER unit that is attached to a Bodyguard unit is destroyed and there is not another CHARACTER unit attached, that Attached unit’s Bodyguard unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time a unit that is part of an Attached unit is destroyed, it does not have the keywords of any other units that make up that Attached unit (unless it has those keywords on its own datasheet) for the purposes of any rules that would be triggered when that unit is destroyed.

Example: If you only destroy the Bodyguard unit that is part of an Attached unit, you have not destroyed a CHARACTER unit. If you only destroy the CHARACTER unit that is part of an Attached unit, or if you destroy the whole Attached unit, you have destroyed one CHARACTER unit.

  • Before the battle, CHARACTER units with the Leader ability can be attached to one of their Bodyguard units to form an Attached unit.
  • Attached units can only contain one Leader.
  • Attacks cannot be allocated to CHARACTER models in Attached units.

abilities.name: Feel No Pain 5+
abilities.description:
FEEL NO PAIN
Some models have ‘Feel No Pain x+’ listed in their abilities. Each time a model with this ability suffers damage and so would lose a wound (including wounds lost due to mortal wounds), roll one D6: if the result is greater than or equal to the number denoted by ‘x’, that wound is ignored and is not lost. If a model has more than one Feel No Pain ability, you can only use one of those abilities each time that model suffers damage and so would lose a wound.

  • Feel No Pain x+: Each time this model would lose a wound, roll one D6: if the result equals or exceeds ‘x’, that wound is not lost.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
LEADER
Some CHARACTER units have ‘Leader’ listed on their datasheets. Such CHARACTER units are known as Leaders, and the units they can lead – known as their Bodyguard units – are listed on their datasheet.

During the Declare Battle Formations step, for each Leader in your army, if your army also includes one or more of that Leader’s Bodyguard units, you can select one of those Bodyguard units. That Leader will then attach to that Bodyguard unit for the duration of the battle and is said to be leading that unit. Each Bodyguard unit can only have one Leader attached to it.

While a Bodyguard unit contains a Leader, it is known as an Attached unit and, with the exception of rules that are triggered when units are destroyed, it is treated as a single unit for all rules purposes. Each time an attack targets an Attached unit, until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, you must use the Toughness characteristic of the Bodyguard models in that unit, even if a Leader in that unit has a different Toughness characteristic. Each time an attack sucessfully wounds an Attached unit, that attack cannot be allocated to a CHARACTER model in that unit, even if that CHARACTER model has lost one or more wounds or has already had attacks allocated to it this phase. As soon as the last Bodyguard model in an Attached unit has been destroyed, any attacks made against that unit that have yet to be allocated can then be allocated to CHARACTER models in that unit.

Each time the last model in a Bodyguard unit is destroyed, each CHARACTER unit that is part of that Attached unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time the last model in a CHARACTER unit that is attached to a Bodyguard unit is destroyed and there is not another CHARACTER unit attached, that Attached unit’s Bodyguard unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time a unit that is part of an Attached unit is destroyed, it does not have the keywords of any other units that make up that Attached unit (unless it has those keywords on its own datasheet) for the purposes of any rules that would be triggered when that unit is destroyed.

Example: If you only destroy the Bodyguard unit that is part of an Attached unit, you have not destroyed a CHARACTER unit. If you only destroy the CHARACTER unit that is part of an Attached unit, or if you destroy the whole Attached unit, you have destroyed one CHARACTER unit.

  • Before the battle, CHARACTER units with the Leader ability can be attached to one of their Bodyguard units to form an Attached unit.
  • Attached units can only contain one Leader.
  • Attacks cannot be allocated to CHARACTER models in Attached units.

On a 4+, do not remove it from play; that destroyed model can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

abilities.name: Feel No Pain 6+
abilities.description:
FEEL NO PAIN
Some models have ‘Feel No Pain x+’ listed in their abilities. Each time a model with this ability suffers damage and so would lose a wound (including wounds lost due to mortal wounds), roll one D6: if the result is greater than or equal to the number denoted by ‘x’, that wound is ignored and is not lost. If a model has more than one Feel No Pain ability, you can only use one of those abilities each time that model suffers damage and so would lose a wound.

  • Feel No Pain x+: Each time this model would lose a wound, roll one D6: if the result equals or exceeds ‘x’, that wound is not lost.

abilities.name: Deadly Demise D3
abilities.description:
DEADLY DEMISE
Some models have ‘Deadly Demise x’ listed in their abilities. When such a model is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it from play (if such a model is a TRANSPORT, roll before any embarked models disembark). On a 6, each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by ‘x’ (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").

Example: A TRANSPORT model with the Deadly Demise D3 ability is destroyed. Before any models disembark and before removing it from play, its controlling player rolls one D6, getting a 6. There are three units within 6" of that destroyed model, so its controlling player rolls one D3 for each of them, inflicting mortal wounds accordingly.

  • Deadly Demise x: When this model is destroyed, roll one D6. On a 6, each unit within 6" suffers ‘x’ mortal wounds.

Some CHARACTER units have ‘Leader’ listed on their datasheets. Such CHARACTER units are known as Leaders, and the units they can lead – known as their Bodyguard units – are listed on their datasheet.

During the Declare Battle Formations step, for each Leader in your army, if your army also includes one or more of that Leader’s Bodyguard units, you can select one of those Bodyguard units. That Leader will then attach to that Bodyguard unit for the duration of the battle and is said to be leading that unit. Each Bodyguard unit can only have one Leader attached to it.

While a Bodyguard unit contains a Leader, it is known as an Attached unit and, with the exception of rules that are triggered when units are destroyed, it is treated as a single unit for all rules purposes. Each time an attack targets an Attached unit, until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, you must use the Toughness characteristic of the Bodyguard models in that unit, even if a Leader in that unit has a different Toughness characteristic. Each time an attack sucessfully wounds an Attached unit, that attack cannot be allocated to a CHARACTER model in that unit, even if that CHARACTER model has lost one or more wounds or has already had attacks allocated to it this phase. As soon as the last Bodyguard model in an Attached unit has been destroyed, any attacks made against that unit that have yet to be allocated can then be allocated to CHARACTER models in that unit.

Each time the last model in a Bodyguard unit is destroyed, each CHARACTER unit that is part of that Attached unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time the last model in a CHARACTER unit that is attached to a Bodyguard unit is destroyed and there is not another CHARACTER unit attached, that Attached unit’s Bodyguard unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time a unit that is part of an Attached unit is destroyed, it does not have the keywords of any other units that make up that Attached unit (unless it has those keywords on its own datasheet) for the purposes of any rules that would be triggered when that unit is destroyed.

Example: If you only destroy the Bodyguard unit that is part of an Attached unit, you have not destroyed a CHARACTER unit. If you only destroy the CHARACTER unit that is part of an Attached unit, or if you destroy the whole Attached unit, you have destroyed one CHARACTER unit.

  • Before the battle, CHARACTER units with the Leader ability can be attached to one of their Bodyguard units to form an Attached unit.
  • Attached units can only contain one Leader.
  • Attacks cannot be allocated to CHARACTER models in Attached units.

abilities.name: Deadly Demise D3
abilities.description:
DEADLY DEMISE
Some models have ‘Deadly Demise x’ listed in their abilities. When such a model is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it from play (if such a model is a TRANSPORT, roll before any embarked models disembark). On a 6, each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by ‘x’ (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").

Example: A TRANSPORT model with the Deadly Demise D3 ability is destroyed. Before any models disembark and before removing it from play, its controlling player rolls one D6, getting a 6. There are three units within 6" of that destroyed model, so its controlling player rolls one D3 for each of them, inflicting mortal wounds accordingly.

  • Deadly Demise x: When this model is destroyed, roll one D6. On a 6, each unit within 6" suffers ‘x’ mortal wounds.

During the Declare Battle Formations step, for each Leader in your army, if your army also includes one or more of that Leader’s Bodyguard units, you can select one of those Bodyguard units. That Leader will then attach to that Bodyguard unit for the duration of the battle and is said to be leading that unit. Each Bodyguard unit can only have one Leader attached to it.

While a Bodyguard unit contains a Leader, it is known as an Attached unit and, with the exception of rules that are triggered when units are destroyed, it is treated as a single unit for all rules purposes. Each time an attack targets an Attached unit, until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, you must use the Toughness characteristic of the Bodyguard models in that unit, even if a Leader in that unit has a different Toughness characteristic. Each time an attack sucessfully wounds an Attached unit, that attack cannot be allocated to a CHARACTER model in that unit, even if that CHARACTER model has lost one or more wounds or has already had attacks allocated to it this phase. As soon as the last Bodyguard model in an Attached unit has been destroyed, any attacks made against that unit that have yet to be allocated can then be allocated to CHARACTER models in that unit.

Each time the last model in a Bodyguard unit is destroyed, each CHARACTER unit that is part of that Attached unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time the last model in a CHARACTER unit that is attached to a Bodyguard unit is destroyed and there is not another CHARACTER unit attached, that Attached unit’s Bodyguard unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time a unit that is part of an Attached unit is destroyed, it does not have the keywords of any other units that make up that Attached unit (unless it has those keywords on its own datasheet) for the purposes of any rules that would be triggered when that unit is destroyed.

Example: If you only destroy the Bodyguard unit that is part of an Attached unit, you have not destroyed a CHARACTER unit. If you only destroy the CHARACTER unit that is part of an Attached unit, or if you destroy the whole Attached unit, you have destroyed one CHARACTER unit.

  • Before the battle, CHARACTER units with the Leader ability can be attached to one of their Bodyguard units to form an Attached unit.
  • Attached units can only contain one Leader.
  • Attacks cannot be allocated to CHARACTER models in Attached units.

Some models have ‘Deadly Demise x’ listed in their abilities. When such a model is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it from play (if such a model is a TRANSPORT, roll before any embarked models disembark). On a 6, each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by ‘x’ (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").

Example: A TRANSPORT model with the Deadly Demise D3 ability is destroyed. Before any models disembark and before removing it from play, its controlling player rolls one D6, getting a 6. There are three units within 6" of that destroyed model, so its controlling player rolls one D3 for each of them, inflicting mortal wounds accordingly.

Some TRANSPORT models have ‘Firing Deck x’ listed in their abilities. Each time such a model is selected to shoot in the Shooting phase, you can select up to ‘x’ models embarked within it whose units have not already shot this phase. Then, for each of those embarked models, you can select one ranged weapon that embarked model is equipped with (excluding weapons with the [ONE SHOT] ability). Until that TRANSPORT model has resolved all of its attacks, it counts as being equipped with all of the weapons you selected in this way, in addition to its other weapons. Until the end of the phase, those selected models’ units are not eligible to shoot.

  • Firing Deck ‘x’: Each time this TRANSPORT shoots, select one weapon (excluding weapons with the [ONE SHOT] ability) from up to ‘x’ models embarked within it whose units have not shot this phase; this TRANSPORT counts as being equipped with those weapons as well. abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
LEADER
Some CHARACTER units have ‘Leader’ listed on their datasheets. Such CHARACTER units are known as Leaders, and the units they can lead – known as their Bodyguard units – are listed on their datasheet.

During the Declare Battle Formations step, for each Leader in your army, if your army also includes one or more of that Leader’s Bodyguard units, you can select one of those Bodyguard units. That Leader will then attach to that Bodyguard unit for the duration of the battle and is said to be leading that unit. Each Bodyguard unit can only have one Leader attached to it.

While a Bodyguard unit contains a Leader, it is known as an Attached unit and, with the exception of rules that are triggered when units are destroyed, it is treated as a single unit for all rules purposes. Each time an attack targets an Attached unit, until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, you must use the Toughness characteristic of the Bodyguard models in that unit, even if a Leader in that unit has a different Toughness characteristic. Each time an attack sucessfully wounds an Attached unit, that attack cannot be allocated to a CHARACTER model in that unit, even if that CHARACTER model has lost one or more wounds or has already had attacks allocated to it this phase. As soon as the last Bodyguard model in an Attached unit has been destroyed, any attacks made against that unit that have yet to be allocated can then be allocated to CHARACTER models in that unit.

Each time the last model in a Bodyguard unit is destroyed, each CHARACTER unit that is part of that Attached unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time the last model in a CHARACTER unit that is attached to a Bodyguard unit is destroyed and there is not another CHARACTER unit attached, that Attached unit’s Bodyguard unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time a unit that is part of an Attached unit is destroyed, it does not have the keywords of any other units that make up that Attached unit (unless it has those keywords on its own datasheet) for the purposes of any rules that would be triggered when that unit is destroyed.

Example: If you only destroy the Bodyguard unit that is part of an Attached unit, you have not destroyed a CHARACTER unit. If you only destroy the CHARACTER unit that is part of an Attached unit, or if you destroy the whole Attached unit, you have destroyed one CHARACTER unit.

  • Before the battle, CHARACTER units with the Leader ability can be attached to one of their Bodyguard units to form an Attached unit.
  • Attached units can only contain one Leader.
  • Attacks cannot be allocated to CHARACTER models in Attached units.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
LEADER
Some CHARACTER units have ‘Leader’ listed on their datasheets. Such CHARACTER units are known as Leaders, and the units they can lead – known as their Bodyguard units – are listed on their datasheet.

During the Declare Battle Formations step, for each Leader in your army, if your army also includes one or more of that Leader’s Bodyguard units, you can select one of those Bodyguard units. That Leader will then attach to that Bodyguard unit for the duration of the battle and is said to be leading that unit. Each Bodyguard unit can only have one Leader attached to it.

While a Bodyguard unit contains a Leader, it is known as an Attached unit and, with the exception of rules that are triggered when units are destroyed, it is treated as a single unit for all rules purposes. Each time an attack targets an Attached unit, until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, you must use the Toughness characteristic of the Bodyguard models in that unit, even if a Leader in that unit has a different Toughness characteristic. Each time an attack sucessfully wounds an Attached unit, that attack cannot be allocated to a CHARACTER model in that unit, even if that CHARACTER model has lost one or more wounds or has already had attacks allocated to it this phase. As soon as the last Bodyguard model in an Attached unit has been destroyed, any attacks made against that unit that have yet to be allocated can then be allocated to CHARACTER models in that unit.

Each time the last model in a Bodyguard unit is destroyed, each CHARACTER unit that is part of that Attached unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time the last model in a CHARACTER unit that is attached to a Bodyguard unit is destroyed and there is not another CHARACTER unit attached, that Attached unit’s Bodyguard unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time a unit that is part of an Attached unit is destroyed, it does not have the keywords of any other units that make up that Attached unit (unless it has those keywords on its own datasheet) for the purposes of any rules that would be triggered when that unit is destroyed.

Example: If you only destroy the Bodyguard unit that is part of an Attached unit, you have not destroyed a CHARACTER unit. If you only destroy the CHARACTER unit that is part of an Attached unit, or if you destroy the whole Attached unit, you have destroyed one CHARACTER unit.

  • Before the battle, CHARACTER units with the Leader ability can be attached to one of their Bodyguard units to form an Attached unit.
  • Attached units can only contain one Leader.
  • Attacks cannot be allocated to CHARACTER models in Attached units.
